title: The Demon in the Synagogue at Capernaum
description: On the Sabbath, Jesus teaches in the synagogue at Capernaum, and people are amazed by his teaching, for he teaches with authority and not like the scribes. A man with an unclean spirit cries out: "What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!" Jesus speaks sternly to the spirit and says: "Be silent and come out of him!" The unclean spirit convulses the man, cries out loudly, and comes out of him. Everyone is filled with awe and discusses what this new teaching is – he even commands the unclean spirits, and they obey him. The news about Jesus spreads quickly throughout Galilee.
